title: Rabbi Chanan (a Tanna of a Baraita)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Sukkah 9b and [Sukkah 16a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.16a.1): Rabbi Chanan speaks in Rabbi’s name. In Megillah 14a he speaks in Rabbi Meir’s name. In [Berakhot 56b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.56b.8): “Rabbi Chanan said: There are three [symbols of] peace: a river, a bird and a pot.” Rabbi Chanina said: “And we learned of a pot that has no meat in it.”
He is mentioned in Zuckermandel’s Tosefta at the end of Ohalot.[^1]

notes.text: In the linked Sukkah, the chain introduces the ruling about the parts of a bed. The pot in the linked Berakhot is part of Rabbi Chanan’s list of dream signs. Rabbi Chanina adds the qualification about meat.
